original.statement: Istio 1.24.0 adds the Kubernetes recommended labels app.kubernetes.io/name, app.kubernetes.io/instance, app.kubernetes.io/part-of, app.kubernetes.io/version, app.kubernetes.io/managed-by, and helm.sh/chart to almost all resources.

decision.reason: [ev-d4a0f83c6c05] says only that Istio added the app.kubernetes.io/* and helm.sh/chart labels to almost all resources. That is metadata added to rendered resources, not a supported-version boundary of a platform or managed operand, so the compatibility-boundary family is wrong, and 'kubernetes-recommended-labels' is not a boundary name. No other subject family (Helm value, CRD field, config key and so on) is named or fits, so no corrected assertion follows from the evidence.
